message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Fifteen newly published, credible advisory findings matched the primary product scope during the 24-hour window (2026-09-24 23:40 UTC through 2026-09-25 23:40 UTC). Eleven affect Elasticsearch or Kibana; four are deduplicated Ubuntu advisory groups. No qualifying MongoDB ecosystem finding was identified.

### Findings

**1. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-94408 (ESA-2026-184)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 4.9)
- Description: Uncontrolled resource consumption can cause denial of service in all Elasticsearch configurations.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored. Affected: 8.0.0–8.19.21, 9.0.0–9.4.6, and 9.5.0–9.5.2; fixed in 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.3.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-3-security-update-esa-2026-184/390688)

**2. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-94397 (ESA-2026-183)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Uncontrolled resource consumption can lead to denial of service.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored; fixed releases are 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.4.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-4-security-update-esa-2026-183/390687)

**3. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-94396 (ESA-2026-182)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Elasticsearch 9.x can cause denial of service.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored; fixed releases are 9.4.7 and 9.5.4.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-9-4-7-9-5-4-security-update-esa-2026-182/390686)

**4. Kibana — CVE-2026-94400 (ESA-2026-181)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Uncontrolled resource consumption can cause denial of service.
- Relevance: Kibana is explicitly monitored; fixed releases are 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.3.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-3-security-update-esa-2026-181/390685)

**5. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-94399 (ESA-2026-180)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Uncontrolled resource consumption can cause denial of service.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored. Affected: 8.0.0–8.19.21, 9.0.0–9.4.6, and 9.5.0–9.5.3; fixed in 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.4.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-4-security-update-esa-2026-180/390684)

**6. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-94398 (ESA-2026-179)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Uncontrolled resource consumption can cause denial of service.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored. Affected: 8.12.0–8.19.21 and 9.0.0–9.5.3; fixed in 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.4.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-4-security-update-esa-2026-179/390683)

**7. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-82300 (ESA-2026-176)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Authenticated users can trigger denial of service through uncontrolled resource consumption in index-analysis APIs.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored; fixed releases are 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.4.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-4-security-update-esa-2026-176/390682)

**8. Elasticsearch — CVE-2026-82294 (ESA-2026-170)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: An analytical aggregation can cause denial of service through uncontrolled resource consumption.
- Relevance: Elasticsearch is explicitly monitored. Affected: 8.0.0–8.19.20, 9.0.0–9.4.5, and 9.5.0–9.5.2; fixed in 8.19.21, 9.4.6, and 9.5.3.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/elasticsearch-8-19-21-9-4-6-9-5-3-security-update-esa-2026-170/390681)

**9. Kibana — CVE-2026-78582 (ESA-2026-139)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.5)
- Description: Missing authorization lets authenticated users with Synthetics privileges delete shared monitor data across Kibana spaces.
- Relevance: Kibana is explicitly monitored; fixed releases are 8.19.22, 9.4.7, and 9.5.3.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-22-9-4-7-9-5-3-security-update-esa-2026-139/390680)

**10. Kibana — CVE-2026-72662 (ESA-2026-103)**
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 6.3)
- Description: An authenticated user can bypass Timeline access controls to disclose, modify, or delete data.
- Relevance: Kibana is explicitly monitored; fixed releases include 8.19.22 and 9.4.6.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-8-19-22-9-4-6-security-update-esa-2026-103/390679)

**11. Kibana — CVE-2026-72668 (ESA-2026-85)**
- Severity: High (CVSS 7.3)
- Description: A confused-deputy flaw in Agent Builder and Workflows can let a non-administrative user cause privileged operations and potentially gain full Kibana and Elasticsearch administrative control.
- Relevance: Kibana is explicitly monitored. Affected: 9.4.0–9.4.6 when Agent Builder and Workflows are enabled; fixed in 9.4.7.
- Source: [Elastic advisory](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/kibana-9-4-7-9-5-0-security-update-esa-2026-85/390678)

**12. Ubuntu 24.04 LTS AWS FIPS kernel — USN-8729-5**
- Severity: Not clearly stated by Canonical
- Description: Canonical fixed 97 kernel CVEs spanning networking, filesystems, memory management, drivers, security modules, and other subsystems; exploitation could potentially compromise a system.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored; this notice applies specifically to the Ubuntu 24.04 AWS FIPS kernel.
- Source: [Canonical advisory](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8729-5)

**13. Ubuntu legacy kernels — USN-8819-2 and USN-8730-6**
- Severity: Not clearly stated by Canonical
- Description: Canonical published fixes for CVE-2025-38724, CVE-2026-53221, and CVE-2026-53131; the last CVE also received an Intel IoTG kernel update.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored. The notices cover Ubuntu 18.04/16.04 kernels and Ubuntu 20.04 Intel IoTG; overlapping CVE-2026-53131 was deduplicated.
- Sources: [USN-8819-2](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8819-2), [USN-8730-6](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8730-6)

**14. Ubuntu 20.04 IBM kernel — USN-8818-2**
- Severity: Not clearly stated by Canonical
- Description: Canonical published an IBM-kernel security update covering 20 CVEs, including CVE-2026-63912, CVE-2026-63984, and CVE-2026-63924.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored; this notice applies to Ubuntu 20.04 systems using the IBM kernel.
- Source: [Canonical advisory](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8818-2)

**15. Ubuntu libpcap — CVE-2026-0799 (USN-8824-1)**
- Severity: Not clearly stated by Canonical
- Description: Improper BPF-instruction validation can permit out-of-bounds memory operations and crash applications processing crafted packet data.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored; affected packages span Ubuntu 14.04 through 26.04 LTS.
- Source: [Canonical advisory](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8824-1)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services. The [official MongoDB security alert feed](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) showed no entry newer than September 18, so no MongoDB-family advisory qualified.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for Kibana CVE-2026-72668 because Elastic rates it High and it can lead to administrative control in affected configurations. The remaining Elastic denial-of-service and authorization issues, plus the applicable Ubuntu kernel and libpcap notices, should be assessed against deployed versions and package flavors.
